title: The cocycle diagram of a descent datum is a split equalizer
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file descent.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: For a descent datum (M, theta) over R contained in S, the lemma states that the diagram with the two maps from M tensor S_2 to M tensor S_3 is a split equalizer (statement lines 1328-1342). The proof is a construction: the author writes down the three ring homomorphisms from S_2 to S_1 and from S_3 to S_2 given by multiplying the two outer factors and by multiplying the first two or the last two factors, uses their base changes along M as the auxiliary morphisms of the splitting, and verifies the needed compatibilities: the first follows by tensoring the cocycle condition with one of the homomorphisms and the others are immediate (proof lines 1344-1359). The claim is H2: the content is the explicit choice of the splitting maps and the observation that the cocycle condition is exactly the compatibility they must satisfy, all written out.
